rationales.F03: Polyarthritis is a common feature of several connective tissue diseases, including Systemic Sclerosis, Mixed Connective Tissue Disease, and Rheumatoid Arthritis.
rationales.F04: Joint swelling is a common feature of several connective tissue diseases, including Systemic Sclerosis, Mixed Connective Tissue Disease, and Rheumatoid Arthritis.
rationales.F05: A 3-year history of progressive dyspnea is suggestive of Idiopathic Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension or Pulmonary Hypertension associated with Connective Tissue Disease.
rationales.F06: NYHA class IV indicates severe pulmonary hypertension, which is consistent with Idiopathic Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension or Pulmonary Hypertension associated with Connective Tissue Disease.
rationales.F07: Orthopnea is a symptom of pulmonary hypertension, which is consistent with Idiopathic Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension or Pulmonary Hypertension associated with Connective Tissue Disease.
rationales.F10: A PASP of 80 mm Hg is indicative of pulmonary hypertension, which is consistent with Idiopathic Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension or Pulmonary Hypertension associated with Connective Tissue Disease.
rationales.F12: An antinuclear antibody titer of 1:320 is suggestive of an autoimmune disorder, such as Systemic Sclerosis or Mixed Connective Tissue Disease.
